title: portwright failure note frontmatter
description: Contract for the YAML frontmatter of a failures/YYYY-MM-DD-<service>-<desc>.md lesson note. Reference/contract doc; bin/portwright lint enforces this with the Python stdlib (no jsonschema dependency at runtime). The note body must also carry a non-empty root-cause section (a heading containing '진짜 원인' or 'root cause').

service.description: Service id this lesson belongs to, e.g. vercel.

service_version.description: Service/MCP version at the time — distrust the lesson if the version moved.

distributable.description: true = safe to ship via git; false = personal Lesson kept under failures/_private/.
